## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.x (latest) | Yes |
| < 1.0   | No |

Security fixes land in the latest 1.x release. See the root
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for what a fix may and may not change, and
[docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](../docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) for the rules every 1.x release
follows.
